authorization_source: Owner message: follow Claude plan with Codex corrections and report while implementing it.

supersedes_by_reference_only.preserved_interpretation: B6A remains a non-serving platform proof and is not B6.1 or full B6.
Packet 003A is closed and cannot resume.
The failed-closed image-scan evidence remains immutable.

design_change.previous_boundary: The model-loader init container downloaded, verified and GPU-smoke-tested the artifact before the ASR container started.
new_model_loader_responsibility: Download only the exact authorized manifest and artifact objects.
Verify manifest SHA-256, every artifact file size and SHA-256, and the canonical artifact-tree SHA-256.
Write one atomic schema-v2 artifact-verification marker and exit zero.
Request no GPU and contain no inference, CTranslate2, CUDA, AV, ONNX or NumPy dependency.
new_asr_runtime_responsibility: Refuse any missing, malformed, wrong-version or incomplete artifact-verification marker.
Load the exact CTranslate2 float16 model on the serving CUDA path.
Run one bounded inference with the bound decode configuration before setting ready=true.
Keep /readyz false when model load or smoke inference fails.
design_change.probe_contract: Kubernetes startupProbe polls /readyz. The probe does not execute inference; it observes the one-time ASR initialization result.
design_change.reason: This removes duplicate GPU model initialization and the unnecessary serving attack surface from the loader while preserving fail-closed artifact and runtime proof.

image_security_direction.model_loader: Use a pinned musl-based Python image, remove the unused SQLite extension and package, and require zero critical/high findings after the final dependency build.
image_security_direction.asr_runtime: Use a pinned CUDA/cuDNN serving base with OS security updates and no duplicate pip-installed CUDA libraries; require zero critical/high findings from local and ECR scans.
image_security_direction.waiver: No B4 or serving vulnerability waiver is extended or created by this decision.

allowed_operations: Local service, container, Kubernetes-template and architecture-source engineering
Local deterministic builds, package inspection, unit and behavioral tests
Local Docker Scout and other read-only vulnerability scans
Preparation of a separate ECR registry-scanning change packet
Preparation of B6A AWS change packet 2026-003B
prohibited_operations: Any AWS mutation under this design decision
Any write to approved/asr/ or production SSM
Any model registration, language approval or B5 evidence change
Any claim that B6A, B6.1 or full B6 is complete
required_next_authorization: A new itemized packet and explicit owner approval are required before changing registry scanning configuration or executing any B6A packet 2026-003B AWS operation.
